definitions.\"start_desc\": "**[[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/History/God-War Era/Dying Period|The Dying Period]]** begins (end. 90th of Spring, [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/Indexes/History/Decades/140s BT#145 BT|145 BT]]) as a result of the [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/History/God-War Era/First Death|First Death]]."
definitions.\"end_desc\": "**[[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/History/God-War Era/Dying Period|The Dying Period]]** ends (beg. 26th of Spring, [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/Indexes/History/Decades/170s BT#177 BT|177 BT]]) after the passing of an estimated 90% of all [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/Science/Phenomena/Gods|Gods]]. Coinciding with the end of the [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/History/God-War Era/The Great Poleward Fog Migration|Great Poleward Fog Migration]]."
definitions.\"featured_desc\": "**[[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/History/God-War Era/Dying Period|The Dying Period]]** was a 32 year period of time, beginning with the [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/History/God-War Era/First Death|First Death]]—the start of the [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/History/God-War Era/God-War Era|God-War Era]]—in the year [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/Indexes/History/Decades/170s BT#177 BT|177 BT]] and ending after the first season of [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/Indexes/History/Decades/140s BT#145 BT|145 BT]], coinciding with the end of the [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/History/God-War Era/The Great Poleward Fog Migration|Great Poleward Fog Migration]]. An estimated 90% to 95% of all [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/Science/Phenomena/Gods|Gods]] to ever exist perished during the period, gaining it its name and making it the most deadly period in recorded history."
definitions.\"ff1\": "... during the [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/History/God-War Era/Dying Period|Dying Period]] an average of 2 thousand [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/Science/Phenomena/Gods|Gods]] died every single day?"
definitions.\"desc1\": "**[[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/History/God-War Era/Dying Period|The Dying Period]]** has 17 years remaining. Three quarters of all Gods which will ever exist have passed away."

definitions.\"start_desc\": **[[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/History/God-War Era/First Convening|The First Convening]]** is held by the [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/History/Biographies/Gods/Phenomena Gods/Gods of Earth/God of Fulgurite|God of Fulgurite]]. 20 [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/Science/Phenomena/Gods|Gods]], all of whom witnessed the [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/History/God-War Era/First Death|First Death]], are invited however only 16 arrive. The convening sees the formation of many ideas and theories regarding the [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/History/God-War Era/God-War Era|God-War]].

definitions.\"start_desc\": "**[[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/History/God-War Era/First Death|The First Death]]** occurs as the number of Gods to exist reaches its all-time peak."
definitions.\"featured_desc\": "**[[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/History/God-War Era/First Death|The First Death]]**, recorded in [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/Geography/Stars/Star Systems/Death's System#Death's Star|Death's Star]], published on the 26th of Spring [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/Indexes/History/Decades/170s BT#177 BT|177 BT]], is the earliest instance of a [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/Science/Phenomena/Gods|God]] dying and marks the start of the [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/History/God-War Era/God-War Era|God-War]]. The First Death was caused by and followed the [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/History/God-War Era/Quickening|Quickening]], which saw a rapid increase in the number of Gods across the [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/Geography/Natural Features/Plane|Plane]]. Death's Star would expand into [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/Geography/Stars/Star Systems/Death's System|Death's System]] following the event, as rushed Gods panicked to record their thoughts on the event."

definitions.\"featured_desc\": "**[[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/Science/Phenomena/Natural Personification|Natural Personification]]** is the tendency of [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/Science/Science#Phenomena|phenomena]] in Nature to enter Reality as new unique phenomena. Natural Personification is not a true metaphysical rule, but rather an emergent property caused by the formation of Reality. According to the [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/Science/Models/Universal Strata Model|Universal Strata Model]], Reality is the result of an imperfect interaction between the Real and Unreal. Imperfections and inequality in the Real and Unreal may require the other to compensate during their interaction, drawing from phenomena within Nature."
definitions.\"ff1\": "... that [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/Science/Phenomena/Natural Personification|Natural Personification]] is the tendency of phenomena in Nature to enter Reality as new unique phenomena?"
definitions.\"ff2\": "... that [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/Science/Phenomena/Natural Personification|Natural Personification]] is broken into three distinct forms: Material Concentration, Relational Concentration, and Natural Diffusion?"
definitions.\"ff3\": "... that [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/Science/Phenomena/Natural Personification#Material Concentration|Material Concentration]] occurs as a result of excess [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/Science/Phenomena/Entity (phenomenon)|entities]] in an area, resolving itself through the materialization of one or more [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/Science/Phenomena/Gods|Gods]]?"
definitions.\"ff4\": "... that [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/Science/Phenomena/Natural Personification#Relational Concentration|Relational Concentration]] occurs as the result of Unreal entering Reality in excess—it's unclear how this presents itself, but is theorized to create [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/Science/Phenomena/Stars|stars]]?"
definitions.\"ff5\": "... that [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/Science/Phenomena/Natural Personification#Natural Diffusion|Natural Diffusion]] occurs as a result of Nature naturally seeping into the interaction between the Real and Unreal, generating [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/Science/Phenomena/Limn|limn]]?"

definitions.\"featured_desc\": "**[[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/Science/Phenomena/Stars|Stars]]**, as described in the [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/Science/Models/Universal Strata Model|Universal Strata Model]], are theoretical products of [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/Science/Phenomena/Natural Personification|Natural Personification]]—specifically Relational Concentration. In practice, however, all known stars are the creations of [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/Science/Phenomena/Gods|Gods]] or [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/Science/Phenomena/Organisms|organisms]]. Stars are physical objects that express information in the languages of [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/Culture/Languages/Starscript|Starscript]] and [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/Culture/Languages/God Tongue|God Tongue]]. Stars may be observed every [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/Science/Phenomena/Day & Night|night]] across the entirety of the [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/Geography/Natural Features/Plane|Plane]] by looking up to the [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/Geography/Natural Features/Sky|sky]]. Though the number of visible stars is impacted by various factors of the surrounding environment."
definitions.\"ff1\": "... that, according to the [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/Science/Models/Universal Strata Model|USM]], [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/Science/Phenomena/Stars|stars]] are a result of the Real's inability to handle the Unreal's management? Despite this, no star is known to have come about as a result of completely natural causes."
definitions.\"ff2\": "... that [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/Science/Phenomena/Stars|stars]] hold messages and laws written by the [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/Science/Phenomena/Gods|Gods]]?"
definitions.\"ff3\": "... that only true [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/Science/Phenomena/Stars|stars]] are written in [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/Culture/Languages/Starscript|Starscript]]? Artificial stars can only be written in [[Encyclopedia Mysenvaria/Culture/Languages/God Tongue|God Tongue]]."
